prs.cluster_pick_reason: 1996 implements a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that parses the Accept header per RFC 7231: splits multiple comma-separated media ranges, strips whitespace, reads q-parameters and excludes entries with q=0, and compares type/subtype (supporting wildcards). 2046's visible diff replaces the check with a plain `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')` substring test, which does not honor q=0 exclusions or wildcard media ranges (e.g. `*/*`, `application/*`) and can also false-match unrelated subtypes containing the substring. 1996's approach covers strictly more of the HTTP content-negotiation spec for the same underlying fix.
